# j-town

> jspace is the physics. j-town is the town built on it. A 48-agent multi-agent
> "town" that applies the foundry's mechanisms to each other, running entirely in
> the browser as a static page (no server, no external requests) and also
> headless under Node. Both a live demo and a clonable starter.
> AGPL-3.0-or-later · © 2026 Intuition Labs LLC · Intuition-Labs-LLC/j-town.

The one mechanism, everywhere: a population of readings → an order parameter
(some R) → a gate (some τ) → a verdict (commit / escalate / skip / vent), and
every step leaves a receipt. Steering moves the population before the gate;
folding changes its resolution; reduction finds its normal form. Interpretability,
dispatch, and consensus are the same operation in different bases.

## Entry points

- [index.html](index.html): the browser shell (Canvas-2D + DOM) over the town.
- [src/town/index.js](src/town/index.js): `createTown({ seed })` → `{ state,
  tick(), act(action), subscribe(fn), hash() }`. Pure, seeded, DOM-free.
- [src/render.js](src/render.js): the thin browser driver (imports the town).
- [selftest.mjs](selftest.mjs): no-external-requests grep + boot + R curve +
  confluence check.
- [test/](test/): the `node:test` falsifier suite (50 tests) that drives the same
  modules the page loads.

## The venues (each is the one mechanism in a different base)

- The Plaza — Kuramoto phase coupling → R, the vibe meter (kuramotoR). Hold
  R≥0.9 for 60τ → a crystallization moment. src/town/plaza.js.
- The Door — agreementR + the commit gate; agree → open, disagree → talk it out,
  never fused (L-agree/L6). src/town/door.js.
- The Cellar — a Lafont interaction net reduces to normal form, then re-reduces
  the original backwards; the canonical hashes match (confluence). src/town/cellar.js.
- The Gallery — a 16-d portrait folded 16→8→4, glueR fidelity. src/town/gallery.js.
- The Mood Bar — contrast-set steering h+αv; a concept vector is a property of
  the contrast you chose, not of the model. src/town/moods.js.
- The Tab — the trace ledger; every event is a receipt; identical rows dedupe.
  src/physics/trace.js.
- The Board — trace → loop → workflow → optimization_target → skill; promotion
  needs an explicit signoff (Γ_ext) AND a clean r-history (Γ_sys). Detection
  never promotes (L8). src/town/board.js.

## Physics twins (vendored; edit the package, not the twin)

src/physics/{kuramoto,agreement,fold,inet,steer,trace,rng}.js — DOM-free,
browser-safe, no node: imports, no async/native crypto (canonical net hashes and
ledger dedupe use a synchronous FNV-1a display hash so node and browser match).

## Run

- Browser: open index.html, or `python3 -m http.server`, or the live copy at
  https://intuition-labs-llc.github.io/j-town/.
- Headless: `node --test "test/*.test.js"` and `node selftest.mjs`.

## Provenance (cited, never copied)

- Kuramoto model — Y. Kuramoto (1975); R = |mean(e^{iθ})|.
- Interaction nets — Y. Lafont; HVM2 — Higher Order Company (Apache-2.0).
- Matryoshka Representation Learning — Kusupati et al., arXiv:2205.13147; the
  sheaf reading — The Matryoshka Sheaf, Tej Desai, Intuition Labs.
- steeropathy — github.com/moudrkat/steeropathy (MIT).
- Global workspace of interpretable directions — Transformer Circuits Thread, 2026.
